definitions.explanation: the early part of winter, typically referring to November to early December in Japan

examples.english: The early winter cold pierces the body.

examples.japanese: {初冬|しょとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紅葉|こうよう}→紅葉：04151_kouyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: In early winter, the autumn leaves are still lingering.

examples.japanese: {初冬|しょとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}、⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧お⟦{過|す}ごし→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: In this early winter season, how is everyone doing?

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (beginning/first) + {冬|とう} (winter)

TIME FRAME:
Typically refers to November to early December in Japan, when autumn transitions to winter.

FORMAL GREETINGS:
{初冬|しょとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう} is used in formal letters and correspondence during early winter.

SEASONAL DIVISIONS ({季語|きご}):
Japanese traditionally divides winter (⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧) into:
- {初冬|しょとう} - early winter (November)
- {仲冬|ちゅうとう} - mid-winter (December)
- {晩冬|ばんとう} - late winter (January)

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- ⟦{晩秋|ばんしゅう}→晩秋：08561_banshuu⟧ - late autumn
- ⟦{厳冬|げんとう}→厳冬：08556_gentou⟧ - severe winter
- ⟦{真冬|まふゆ}→真冬：20587_mafuyu⟧ - midwinter
